evidence.finding: sheet 'SPname_files 260909' labels its columns 'SP2 (old)' and 'SP10 (new SP2)'. The 'SP2 (old)' column is exactly the governed fixture set Bravo (1) of the 260803 acquisition (28.0062, 74.376, 78.1616, 90.575, 91.9496, 144.763, 202, 208.216, 219.444 Hz); the 'SP10 (new SP2)' column is SP10_polymax 260831 'Bravo'.

SP-10 (labelled) gives the same spectrum in 260831 and 260911 (first six fitted modes within 1.5 %, modes 2-6 within 0.5 %), while SP-10 is 1.3-6.1 % higher than the 260803 panel (mode 1 29.72 vs 28.01 Hz). The 260803 panel is therefore not the SP-10 panel. SP-09 (labelled, PLA honeycomb, new faces) is far lower (22.6, 51.2, 58.1 Hz).

frames up to 2026-08-03 carry no specimen number (SP-01 260624, SP-05 260706, SP-02 and SP-03 260803); every frame from 2026-08-22 on is numbered (SP-04, SP-06, SP-07, SP-08, SP-09, SP-10, SP-11, SP-13). The unnumbered 260803 label follows the convention of its date.
the 500-class PLA-honeycomb panels in the records are SP-02, SP-09 and SP-10; SP-09 and SP-10 are excluded above; the 300-class honeycomb panels (SP-04, SP-07) do not fit the 500x500 label.
